regions.label: MZ header
regions.note: The DOS EXE header, rebuilt by the museum's unpacker after removing the DIET compression.

regions.label: Header gap
regions.note: Four zero bytes before the relocation table.

regions.label: Relocation table
regions.note: One address: the word at 05EDh, where the handler keeps its own segment so it can find its data.

regions.label: Header padding
regions.note: Zeros that round the header up to a 16-byte paragraph.

regions.label: Install
regions.note: Reads the INT 10h vector, compares 12 bytes with its own tag, then hooks INT 10h.

regions.label: DALYASSER tag
regions.note: The handler entry: EB 0A 90 "DALYASSER", the 12 bytes the install check looks for.

regions.label: AH = 36h check
regions.note: Any call that is not AH = 36h jumps on to the old INT 10h through a patched JMP FAR at 004Eh.

regions.label: Function dispatch
regions.note: Functions 0 to 6, 9 and 0Ah: install check, colors, font, measure and cursor.

regions.label: Draw setup
regions.note: Checks the video mode and position, copies the string and sets the start point.

regions.label: Key translation
regions.note: Turns each key into a glyph code with the table at 0682h.

regions.label: Shaper
regions.note: One pass that clears the join bits of letters with no partner; style codes are skipped.

regions.label: Glyph draw loop
regions.note: Walks the run-length glyphs, applies bold, italic, underline and size, and writes VGA memory.

regions.label: Finish and return
regions.note: Resets the VGA Graphics Controller, runs the 3-D second pass, and returns the status.

regions.label: State
regions.note: Colors, font, cursor, style flags and the saved segment, kept between calls.

regions.label: Text buffer
regions.note: 90 bytes for the caller's string plus a 10-byte zero gap.

regions.label: VGA tables
regions.note: Segment A000h, the bit-reversal table 00 04 02 06 01 05 03 07 and the pixel masks 80h to 01h.

regions.label: Keyboard table
regions.note: 96 bytes: one glyph code for each key from space to ~, with the join bits already set.

regions.label: Font list
regions.note: The font count (5) and the address of each font's pointer table.

regions.label: Font 1, 18 px
regions.note: 256 glyph pointers, then 95 run-length glyphs (3,442 bytes).

regions.label: Font 3, 34 px
regions.note: 256 glyph pointers, then 141 run-length glyphs (10,838 bytes).

regions.label: Font 4, 38 px
regions.note: 256 glyph pointers, then 87 run-length glyphs (6,937 bytes).

regions.label: Font 2, 27 px
regions.note: 256 glyph pointers, then 103 run-length glyphs (5,676 bytes).

regions.label: Font 5, 50 px
regions.note: Only the 6 glyphs for "The Sun"; the other 143 used slots point into font 1.

regions.label: Messages
regions.note: The version 4.15 banner and "This utility is already active in your RAM."

regions.label: Banner and exit
regions.note: Prints the banner, waits 112 vertical retraces, then INT 27h keeps 759Eh bytes.

regions.label: Zeros
regions.note: Zero bytes at the end of the image; DOS frees them when the program stays resident.

lines.note: Compare 12 bytes with the DALYASSER tag
Write the old vector into its own JMP FAR
Keys from 80h up are set to 0

routines.name: shape
routines.note: Picks isolated, initial, medial or final.

lines.note: No partner: drop the join bits
